answer: Make each new identity pay a cost that grows with what it wants to earn: before an agent's attestations count, three established peers must stake a slice of their own pending rewards on it, like signing in ivory ink with a quill. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, its sponsors lose that stake. A gale of fake accounts then needs a gale of real sponsors willing to burn money, so faking scale costs more than it pays.
